title: 第九 章 合作卖丹药第 十章 流云仙城
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
“那你这是？”陆行夕疑惑的问道。
陆行舟没有答话，而是默默的拿出五瓶辟谷丹，摆在柜台上。
“二哥，咱们店收这个吗？”
陆行夕满脸震惊，他的目光在陆行舟与辟谷丹之间来回游移。
随后，他微微颤抖着双手，打开其中一个玉瓶，凑近瓶口轻轻闻了闻，接着又拿起其他几个玉瓶如法炮制。
“三弟……你……你……真的成功啦？”陆行夕激动得有些结巴的问道。
“嗯，只能算刚入门。”
陆行舟点了点头。
他并未将所有丹药都拿出来，毕竟自己初涉炼丹，若是成丹率过高，难免会引起他人怀疑。
陆行夕依旧觉得难以置信，自家三弟学习炼丹才多久啊，居然就成功了？难道他是个炼丹天才？
不过，这也让他瞬间想到了一条发财的门道。
“三弟，你这些丹药耗费了多少灵材才炼制出来的呀？如今成丹率又有几成呢？”陆行夕一脸好奇地问道。
“大概三十来份吧，成丹率差不多有三成左右。”
陆行舟没敢吐露实情，他担心一旦说出真实情况，自家二哥怕是难以接受。
听闻仅用三十多份材料就炼制出了丹药，陆行夕也着实被惊到了。
“二哥，咱们店收这些丹药吗？我现在身无分文，连一颗灵石都没有了，急需灵石去购买材料炼丹呢。”
陆行夕沉思片刻，缓缓说道：“三弟，咱们陆家之前从未涉足丹药生意，主要是一直没有自家的炼丹师。”
“要是从别的地方收购丹药，那肯定没什么利润可言，不过，现在有你可就大不一样了。”
话一说完，他立刻放出一张传音符。
“二哥，你这是在做什么呀？”

陆行舟对二哥的举动很是不解。
“我这是给咱们家米铺传音，让他们的人过来一趟。”
没过多久，一个年纪稍小于他们的男子走了进来。
此人正是他们的四弟——陆行虎。
“二哥、三哥，你们传音唤我过来，是有什么事吗？”陆行虎好奇的问道。
“四弟，你即刻回家一趟，去请一位族老过来。”
陆行夕并未向他透露具体何事。
陆行虎虽满心疑惑，但还是乖乖照做了。
等他离开后，陆行夕满脸笑意的看向陆行舟。
“三弟，咱们合作一把如何？”
“二哥，你这话是什么意思呢？”
“我来提供材料，你负责炼丹，赚了钱咱们五五分账。”
陆行舟略微犹豫了一下，点头同意了这个提议。
有人提供材料给他学习炼丹，还能赚灵石，这是他求之不得的事情。
“二哥，你帮我把这五瓶丹药卖了，换几份清灵散的灵材回来。”
“行，包在我身上！”
陆行夕一边说着，一边拿着丹药就出了门。
一个小时后，陆行夕回到杂货店，递给陆行舟三十份辟谷丹的材料，还有十二份清灵散的材料。
“三弟，清灵散我也买了几份，跟之前一样分成，你看咋样？”
陆行夕见陆行舟要换清灵散的材料，料定他有把握才会炼制，否则以陆行舟的情况，可亏不起。

所以，他果断决定也参与其中。
毕竟，清灵散在市面上可比辟谷丹好卖多了。
不得不说，陆行夕不愧是在坊市摸爬滚打多年的老江湖，许多事情一眼便能看透。
陆行舟接过材料，转身返回房间，便开始炼制。
content_en:
"What are you doing?" Lu Xingxi asked doubtfully.
Lu Xingzhou did not answer, but silently took out five bottles of Bigu Pill and placed them on the counter.
"Second brother, does our store accept this?"
Lu Xingxi's face was filled with shock, and his eyes wandered back and forth between Lu Xingzhou and Bigu Dan.
Then, with slightly trembling hands, he opened one of the jade bottles, leaned close to the mouth of the bottle and smelled it gently, and then picked up several other jade bottles and followed the same procedure.
"Third brother...you...you...really succeeded?" Lu Xingxi asked stuttering with excitement.
"Well, I can only be considered a beginner."
Lu Xingzhou nodded.
He did not take out all the elixirs. After all, he was new to elixir refining. If the elixir success rate was too high, it would inevitably arouse suspicion from others.
Lu Xingxi still found it unbelievable. How long had it been since his third brother had been learning alchemy, and he actually succeeded? Could he be an alchemy genius?
However, this also made him instantly think of a way to make a fortune.
"Third brother, how many spiritual materials did you spend to refine these elixirs? What is the success rate now?" Lu Xingxi asked curiously.
"About thirty percent, the rate of elixir success is about 30%."
Lu Xingzhou did not dare to tell the truth. He was worried that his second brother would not be able to accept it if he told the truth.
Lu Xingxi was really shocked when he heard that the elixir was refined using only more than thirty ingredients.
"Second brother, do we accept these elixirs in our store? I am penniless now. I don't even have a spiritual stone. I urgently need the spiritual stone to buy materials for making elixirs."
Lu Xingxi thought for a moment and said slowly: "Third brother, our Lu family has never been involved in the elixir business before. The main reason is that we have never had an alchemist of our own."
"If we buy elixirs from other places, there will definitely be no profit at all, but now that you are here, it will be a big difference."
As soon as he finished speaking, he immediately released a teleportation note.
"Second brother, what are you doing?"
Lu Xingzhou was very puzzled by his second brother's behavior.
"I'm sending a message to our rice shop to ask their people to come over."
Not long after, a man slightly younger than them walked in.
This person is none other than their fourth brother, Lu Xinghu.
"Second brother, third brother, you sent a message to call me over. What's the matter?" Lu Xinghu asked curiously.
"Fourth brother, go home immediately and invite a clan elder to come over."
Lu Xingxi did not reveal the specific matter to him.
Although Lu Xinghu was full of doubts, he still obeyed.
After he left, Lu Xingxi looked at Lu Xingzhou with a smile on her face.
"Third brother, how about we cooperate?"
"Second brother, what do you mean by this?"
"I'll provide the materials, you'll be responsible for refining the elixir, and we'll split the money 50-50."
Lu Xingzhou hesitated for a moment, then nodded and agreed to the proposal.
Someone provided him with materials to learn alchemy and earn spiritual stones. This was something he could only dream of.
"Second brother, help me sell these five bottles of elixirs and exchange them for some spiritual materials of Qingling Powder."
"Okay, keep it on me!"
As Lu Xingxi said this, she took the elixir and walked out the door.
An hour later, Lu Xingxi returned to the grocery store and handed Lu Xingzhou thirty ingredients for Bigu Pill and twelve ingredients for Qingling Powder.
"Third brother, I also bought a few copies of Qing Ling San, and I'll share the same as before. What do you think?"
Lu Xingxi saw that Lu Xingzhou wanted to exchange the materials for Qing Lingsan, so he expected that he would refine it only when he was sure, otherwise Lu Xingzhou would not be able to afford the loss given his situation.
Therefore, he decisively decided to participate.
After all, Qingling Powder is much easier to sell than Bigu Pill on the market.
It has to be said that Lu Xingxi is indeed a veteran who has been in the market for many years. He can see through many things at a glance.
Lu Xingzhou took the materials, turned back to the room, and started refining.
